## Functions

### `Modal`

```ts
Modal(props: ModalProps): Html
```

A native `<dialog>` — open it with any trigger carrying
`attrs: { "data-modal-open": "#<id>" }` (see modal.js), never by
toggling a CSS class; `.showModal()` is what gets the browser's
built-in focus-trapping and `::backdrop` for free.

| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible title. |

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/modal/modal.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.modal`, `.modal__body`, `.modal__close`, `.modal__footer`, `.modal__header`, `.modal__title`

## Behaviour

`components/modal/modal.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-modal-close`, `data-modal-open`.
